name: Package of Empty Ooze Containers
summary: In Ironforge, Package of Empty Ooze Containers is ready for dangerous field sampling in Felwood. Laris Geardawdle supplies jars built to hold tainted and cursed ooze without dissolving.

sections.title: Field Research Equipment
sections.body: Laris Geardawdle sends a dozen empty jars with travelers bound for Felwood. Six are meant for cursed ooze and six for tainted ooze. Raw specimens are caustic, and ordinary luggage can be digested by them. Sturdy, sealed glass keeps the acidic residue contained on the journey across continents to Laris's workbench in Ironforge.

sections.title: The Mystery of the Ooze
sections.body: Laris Geardawdle's interest in ooze reaches beyond eccentric hobby. He has noticed Forsaken researchers from the Royal Apothecary Society harvesting these strange organisms across Azeroth, and wonders what they know. He suspects slimes may be primordial secretions tied to the world's creation. Field agents use his jars to gather evidence, which he hopes will win him acclaim within the Explorers' League.

faq.q: What is inside the package of empty ooze containers?
faq.answer: The package holds twelve empty specimen jars: six for cursed ooze and six for tainted ooze.

aliases: where do i get the ooze package
faq.answer: Laris Geardawdle, a gnomish scholar and researcher in Ironforge, provides the package to Alliance adventurers.

faq.q: Where are these containers meant to be used?
aliases: where do i use ooze jars
faq.answer: The containers are meant for Felwood. There, adventurers defeat tainted and cursed oozes, then harvest residue from the fallen creatures.

faq.q: Why does Laris Geardawdle want these ooze samples?
faq.answer: Laris has seen the Forsaken Royal Apothecary Society gathering ooze across the world and wants to uncover its secrets. He suspects slimes may be primordial secretions tied to Azeroth's creation, and hopes evidence will earn him status in the Explorers' League.

angles.text: As a gnome, Laris Geardawdle's ooze research gives him a chance to show Ironforge's Dwarves that hosting refugee gnomes was worth the trouble.
As an Alliance member, gathering these samples helps you keep pace with the unsettling research of the Forsaken Royal Apothecary Society.

attribution: A Little Slime Goes a Long Way
